name: IDrive Online
description_en:
IDrive Online Backup protects files from multiple supported devices within a purchased capacity plan. Its backup history and archiving behavior differ from its synchronization feature. IDrive e2 object storage, BMR, 360 and cloud-application add-ons are separate offerings or purchase scopes, not automatically included capabilities of one Personal plan.

This profile uses the Windows application’s backup and recovery workflow. It focuses on what happens after local deletion, cleanup, skipped files and over-quota use; no client or account was tested.
description_zh:
IDrive Online Backup 在购买的容量方案内保护多台受支持设备文件；备份历史和归档行为不同于同步功能。IDrive e2 对象存储、BMR、360 及云应用附加项有各自产品或采购范围，不能视为一个 Personal 套餐自动包含。

本文以 Windows 应用的备份恢复流程为例，重点说明本地删除、清理、跳过文件及超额用量，未测试客户端或账户。

sections.title_en: Local deletion need not remove the cloud backup
sections.title_zh: 本地删除不必然删除云备份
sections.en:
The True Archiving page says backed-up files remain after local deletion unless deleted from the account manually or through Archive Cleanup. This is the important condition behind the marketing word “forever”; the cleanup setting can intentionally make cloud contents follow the current backup set.

For example, a deleted project folder may remain recoverable, but a later cleanup can remove it. Define whether the cloud copy is an archive or a current-set mirror before enabling cleanup. Capacity will also include retained material, so a retention decision has a cost consequence.
sections.zh:
True Archiving 页面说明，文件本地删除后仍保留，除非从账户手动删除或通过 Archive Cleanup 清理。这是“永久”宣传背后的重要条件，清理设置可以让云端内容跟随当前备份集合。

例如，已删项目目录可能仍可恢复，但之后清理会将其移除。启用前应明确云端是历史档案还是当前集合镜像，保留资料也会占容量，因此保留决策影响费用。

sections.en:
The Windows FAQ describes choosing online, local or Express restore, selecting files and a destination, and providing the private key if configured. Restoring to the original location can overwrite current files. Use a spare destination for an evaluation and compare representative content before returning it to service.

A particularly important documented limitation is that a run can report Success while permission-denied files were omitted and listed in logs. Reconcile the critical-file inventory with the log and recovery view. A positive summary alone is not proof of complete coverage.
sections.zh:
Windows FAQ 说明选择在线、本地或 Express 恢复，选择文件和目标，配置过私钥时需提供私钥。恢复到原位置可能覆盖现有文件，评估应使用备用目标，并核对代表性内容后再投入使用。

一个重要文档限制是：权限被拒绝的文件可被跳过并记录日志，但任务仍报 Success。应把关键文件清单与日志及恢复视图对照，成功摘要本身不能证明完整覆盖。

sections.en:
The Personal signup page lists 5 TB at USD 11.99 for monthly billing and a discounted USD 6.99 monthly equivalent on the annually billed view. It says discounts apply to the first applicable period and subsequent periods use standard prices, with automatic renewal. Personal is one user across multiple computers; Team has user/device limits.

The same terms allow certain accounts to exceed capacity and quote Personal overuse at USD 0.25/GB/month, Team/Business at USD 0.50/GB/month. Hypothetically, 100 GB of Personal overuse adds USD 25 for a month. Check actual account terms and tax before treating a promotional headline as the full bill.
sections.zh:
Personal 注册页列 5 TB 月付 11.99 美元，年付视图的优惠月均为 6.99 美元。说明优惠仅适用首个对应周期，之后按标准价格自动续费；Personal 为一个用户多台电脑，Team 有用户／设备限制。

同一条款允许部分账户超容量，Personal 超额每 GB 月 0.25 美元，Team／Business 为 0.50 美元。假设 Personal 超额 100 GB 一个月，加收 25 美元。应检查账户真实条款和税费，不能把优惠标题当完整账单。

sections.title_en: Prove the intended recovery before scaling devices
sections.title_zh: 扩展设备前验证所需恢复
sections.en:
Shortlist IDrive when a capacity pool for eligible multi-device file protection fits. Establish backup sets, exclusions, cleanup policy, key recovery and a test restore first. A file archive does not establish that an operating system or database will restart consistently; evaluate the corresponding machine or application workflow separately.

No throughput, private-key recovery or application consistency was tested. Current regional availability, full legal licensing and exact version compatibility remain unverified. The FAQ contains platform-specific advice that should be matched to the client rather than applied across all IDrive products.
sections.zh:
需要容量池保护多设备合格文件时，可考虑 IDrive。应先明确备份集合、排除、清理策略、密钥恢复及样例恢复。文件归档不能证明系统或数据库可一致重启，需分别评估机器或应用流程。

本文未测试吞吐、私钥恢复或应用一致性，当前地区可用性、完整法律许可和准确版本兼容性未确认。FAQ 的平台建议需匹配客户端，不能套用整个 IDrive 家族。
